children: Veea announced a non-binding term sheet to combine with NovaGen to launch NovaGen Health Networks, integrating Veea’s HealthLynx/VeeaONE edge platform with NovaGen’s regenerative medicine services.
Signed non-binding term sheet with NovaGen to pursue a business combination to launch NovaGen Health Networks.
Platform will integrate Veea’s edge computing, connectivity and cybersecurity with NovaGen’s cellular reprogramming and clinical services.
Parties target definitive agreement in coming weeks; transaction subject to due diligence, approvals and customary closing conditions.
GeoNova Capital committed as cornerstone investor with an initial US$10 million term sheet investment.
Initial deployments planned at NovaGen clinics and partner hospitals in Q4 2026, with phased rollout toward clinician-supervised diagnostics as validations permit.

title: Veea signs term sheet with NovaGen to form NovaGen Health Networks, GeoNova commits $10M
